verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail confirms it has its own API and claims it lets you 'take full control of your workflow', which is a loose parity claim. However, the API is gated behind a contact request, the documentation is not public, and probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404, so there is no evidence of which UI actions (scanning, forwarding, check deposit, shipping, automation rules, tagging) the API actually exposes. Missing for 10: a public API reference, an endpoint-by-endpoint parity map against UI features, a published spec or sandbox, and independent or hands-on confirmation of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: If that's not enough, use our API directly to take full control of your workflow.

we do offer an API that you can use. API access is currently available to those who may know how to program or code software. You can contact us to request for developer information on how to access the API.
